d:
Ameriki rashtrapti tranp ne is sal ki shuruaat men apna dar sajha kiya tha. ab mid tarm chunavon men vahi dar sach sabit hota dikh raha hai.
Par kya isse tranp ko hatae jane ki prakriya aasan huee hai aur amerika men mahabhiyog kaise laya jata hai?
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
